title: Nuclear Posture Review and the motive to discredit witnesses

tellings.quote: nuclear deterrence is the backbone the basis of our national security.

plain: The military is said to have had a reason to discredit people who saw UFOs near nuclear weapons, because its own policy treats those weapons as everything. Robert Salas, a former Air Force officer, makes this case from the Nuclear Posture Review, a Pentagon document that sets out US nuclear policy, quoting it as saying "nuclear deterrence is the backbone the basis of our national security." In his view, anything that made the weapons look vulnerable would be pushed down.
